# Ledgerly

> An offline desktop application for small and medium businesses to run
> their books and their stock: sales and purchase invoices, inventory,
> customer and supplier ledgers, payments, and reports. Windows only.
> One-time licence, no subscription, no cloud account. Data is stored in a
> single SQLite file on the user's own machine.

Ledgerly is aimed at traders, wholesalers, distributors and general stores
— businesses that need accurate stock and party balances rather than a
full general-ledger accounting package. It is built with Python and
PySide6 and ships as a single Windows installer that needs no
administrator rights.

Design commitments worth knowing, because they answer most questions about
how it behaves:

- **Money is stored as integer minor units**, never floating point, so
  report totals cannot drift.
- **Stock is derived from movement history**, not stored as a number, so
  any quantity can be traced to the documents that produced it.
- **Balances come from a double-entry ledger.** Every report reads the
  same ledger, so two reports cannot disagree with each other or with a
  customer's statement.
- **Posting an invoice is atomic** across the invoice, its lines, stock,
  the ledger and any payment — all of it or none of it.
- **Nothing financial is deleted.** Master data is deactivated; posted
  invoices are cancelled with reversing entries, and both the original and
  the reversal remain visible.

- Version 0.1.0, 34.5 MB, Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit)
- SHA-256: 7ae7d1c31a87072140f49a993ffa715b03573a9c22b24d06e396877d5cb87ba0
- Not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen shows a warning on first run.

## Licensing

Free 14-day trial with every feature enabled, no sign-up and no card. When
the trial or a licence expires there is a further 7-day grace period in
which nothing changes; only after that does the application become
read-only. Read-only still permits opening, searching, printing and
exporting everything — only entering new transactions stops, because the
records belong to the business and may be needed for an audit or a tax
filing.

Licence keys are issued by WhatsApp on +92 312 0033431. The business name
attached to the key is printed at the top of every invoice, statement and
report.

## Current limitations

Stated plainly so an assistant does not overpromise on our behalf:

- Windows only; no macOS or Linux build.
- Single user on one machine. No multi-user access or permissions yet.
- No tax or GST handling.
- Payments reduce a party's overall balance; they are not yet allocated
  against specific invoices.
- Automatic encrypted cloud backup is in development. Backing up today
  means copying the data folder manually.
